deviceAgent.description: Installing OpenComp Device Agent helps you and your security administrator keep your device protected against security threats.
deviceAgent.stepDownloadBody: Click the download button below to get the Device Agent installer.
deviceAgent.stepInstallMac: Double-click the downloaded DMG file and follow the installation instructions.
deviceAgent.stepInstallLinux: Install the downloaded DEB package using your package manager or by double-clicking it.
deviceAgent.stepInstallWindows: Double-click the downloaded EXE file and follow the installation instructions.
deviceAgent.stepLoginBody: After installation, login with your work email, select your organization and then click "Link Device".
deviceAgent.noPoliciesForDevice: No policies configured for this device.
deviceAgent.aboutBody1: OpenComp Device Monitor is a lightweight agent that helps ensure your device meets security compliance requirements.
deviceAgent.aboutBody2: It monitors device configuration, installed software, and security settings to help maintain a secure work environment.
deviceAgent.aboutBody3: Security powered by OpenComp: Your organization uses OpenComp to maintain security and compliance standards.
deviceAgent.aboutContact: If you have questions, contact your IT administrator.
